b9079979134faffc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سمايا عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، بمنطقة عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال مراقبة أماكن العمل ومنافذ الدخول. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيلها، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان الأمن. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الأمنية في المنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن والممتلكات بفعالية. القدرة على التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ والاستجابة السريعة. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالتعليمات واللوائح الأمنية. مهارات تواصل جيدة. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في خميس مشيط، عسير، حيث يساهم بشكل مباشر في الحفاظ على أمن وسلامة المنشأة وموظفيها وزوارها. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

b90dc07305aff693.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Lead Pipeline Engineer to join their team. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region and requires extensive experience in onshore pipeline design and project leadership. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading a significant team and providing technical expertise across various project phases. Key Responsibilities Lead a team of 15 or more members in pipeline design projects. Conduct pipeline route selection and optimization studies. Develop and implement pipeline scraping philosophy. Perform advanced pipeline calculations, including road crossing, upheaval buckling, buoyancy, combined stresses, and elastic bends. Provide technical support for construction queries, ensuring compliance with applicable standards. Manage multiple tasks and ensure work aligns with agreed project milestones. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in Onshore Pipeline design, covering Pre-FEED, FEED, and Detail Design phases. Demonstrated experience in leading large teams (15+ members). Strong technical background in pipeline engineering principles and calculations. Proficiency with International Standards such as ASME, API, ASTM, MSS SP, ISO, NACE, and DNV. An Engineering Degree in Mechanical or a relevant field. Required Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Excellent communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a multi-tasking environment. Additional Considerations Experience working in Saudi Arabia. Familiarity with Civil 3D software. Experience with 3D model projects. Work Type This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b91146e2053fbea5.description: About the Role TalentHive is seeking a Senior Accountant to join a well-established and diversified Saudi group in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time position is part of a wider growth and transformation program aimed at strengthening the Finance function. The role requires a technically strong, hands-on accountant capable of demonstrating genuine General Ledger and month-end accounting ownership, alongside specialist experience in areas such as Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets & Inventory, and broader GL accounting. Role Context This is not a transactional accounting position. The ideal candidate will understand the accounting treatment behind transactions and be able to confidently explain and independently manage journals, accruals, reconciliations, and period-end adjustments. The role supports accounting activities across multiple sites, branches, or business units within a complex, multi-site or multi-business environment. Key Responsibilities Take hands-on responsibility for General Ledger accounting and month-end close processes. Prepare and post journals, accruals, prepayments, and adjusting entries. Perform and review balance-sheet and GL reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies. Ensure costs and revenues are recognized in the correct accounting period. Support accounting activities across multiple sites, branches, or business units. Take specialist responsibility across areas such as Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets, Inventory, and/or other GL accounts. Manage asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, Construction Work In Progress (CWIP), transfers, and disposals where applicable. Support inventory accounting, including reconciliations, valuation, provisions, slow-moving/obsolete stock, and adjustments. Support AR accounting, including invoicing, ageing, collections, reconciliations, provisions, and month-end close where applicable. Maintain strong financial controls, supporting schedules, and audit-ready documentation. Work closely with Operations, Procurement, Projects, Stores, and other Finance teams. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in accounting roles. Demonstrated technical accounting capability. Experience operating across a complex, multi-site, or multi-business environment. Ability to demonstrate why an accounting treatment was applied, rather than simply following an established process. Experience across areas such as CWIP/project accounting, asset capitalization, borrowing costs, inventory provisions, revenue/cost recognition, accruals, and period-end adjustments is valuable. Specific industry experience is not essential. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

b93e0752567456e5.description: About the Role BRC Industrial Saudia is seeking a Control / Electronic Machine Repair Technician to join their team in the Makkah region, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position involves maintaining and repairing industrial machinery, ensuring operational efficiency and minimizing downtime. Role Overview The Control / Electronic Machine Repair Technician will be responsible for the diagnosis, repair, and maintenance of complex industrial control systems and electronic components. This role requires a strong technical background in electronics and control systems to support continuous production operations. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair industrial machinery control systems, including PLCs, VFDs, servo drives, and HMIs. Perform component-level diagnostics and repair on electronic circuit boards (PCBs), power supplies, and control cards. Read and interpret electrical, electronic, and control schematics and wiring diagrams. Inspect, calibrate, and replace faulty sensors, encoders, relays, contactors, and actuators. Execute preventive and corrective maintenance schedules to minimize production downtime. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a similar role. Demonstrated ability to work with industrial control systems and electronic components. Proficiency in interpreting technical diagrams and schematics. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities spanning both Jeddah and Makkah. The role operates within an industrial setting, focusing on the maintenance and repair of production machinery. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b93ee973aeac8cd5.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise known for its innovation and comprehensive end-to-end services. The firm supports clients from conceptualization to the realization of planning, design, or project delivery across built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to numerous significant projects globally and is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and a Top 20 International PM/CM Firm. World Architecture also ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role of Planning Engineer KEO International Consultants is seeking a Planning Engineer to join its team. This full-time position involves developing, monitoring, and analyzing project schedules and performance. The role requires coordination with project leadership and active participation in various aspects of project control and reporting. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain project schedules, sequencing, phasing, and logistics in coordination with the Senior Planning Engineer and Project Leadership. Monitor and analyze project progress, cost data, productivity, and earned value metrics, reporting performance against approved plans. Review contractor work programs, verify actual progress, and assess schedule compliance and delays. Manage schedule updates in Primavera and support delay analysis, change orders, and Extension of Time (EOT) evaluations. Monitor cost plans and cash flows, consolidating results into monthly consultant and project control reports. Prepare and report KPIs, project metrics, and risk-related inputs appropriate to the project stage. Coordinate long-lead item schedules and support procurement tracking with contractors and suppliers. Participate in contract administration, project meetings, and monthly reporting activities. Required Qualifications and Skills Proven experience across various project types. Solid understanding of delay analysis methodologies and claim review and preparation. Strong knowledge of relevant laws and regulations. Proficiency in Primavera P6 and other planning tools (for review purposes). Working at KEO Joining KEO offers a supportive environment focused on professional development through internal global mobility and career advancement. The company culture promotes health and well-being with on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. In addition to a competitive package and benefits, KEO provides access to policies including hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards.

b950122f6f5f97b8.description: About the Role IHCC is seeking a Senior Procurement Engineer Electrical to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in either Jeddah or Makkah and requires 5-10 years of experience. The Senior Procurement Engineer Electrical will be responsible for managing and executing procurement activities related to electrical materials, equipment, and services. This involves developing procurement strategies, sourcing qualified suppliers, evaluating offers, negotiating terms, and ensuring timely delivery in accordance with project requirements and company policies. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end procurement process for electrical materials, equipment, and services. Review purchase requisitions, technical specifications, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), drawings, and project requirements. Identify, evaluate, and prequalify suitable local and international electrical suppliers and subcontractors. Prepare and issue Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and conduct commercial and technical evaluations of supplier quotations. Coordinate with Engineering, Projects, Operations, Finance, and other relevant departments to ensure procurement requirements are clearly defined. Review technical compliance of supplier offers in coordination with the Engineering/Technical team. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and other commercial conditions with suppliers. Prepare and issue Purchase Orders, Work Orders, and other procurement-related documents in accordance with approved procedures and ERP (Oracle). Monitor supplier performance, order status, lead times, and delivery schedules to ensure timely project execution. Follow up on long-lead electrical materials and equipment and proactively identify potential delays or risks. Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, approval authorities, and applicable procedures. Maintain and update procurement trackers, supplier databases, cost comparisons, and procurement reports. Support cost-saving initiatives and identify opportunities for value engineering and commercial optimization. Resolve supplier-related issues concerning delivery, quality, documentation, and commercial matters. Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained throughout the procurement cycle. Support contract and supplier performance management when required. Mentor and provide guidance to junior procurement engineers and procurement team members. Perform market research and monitor price trends, availability, and developments within the electrical supply market. Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, ethical procurement, and supplier code of conduct requirements. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related field. Strong experience (5-10 years) in the procurement of electrical materials, equipment, and systems. Good knowledge of electrical products such as LV/MV panels, transformers, generators, cables, lighting systems, cable trays, switchgear, UPS systems, earthing systems, and related electrical components, including ICT packages. Experience in supplier sourcing, technical/commercial evaluation, negotiation, and contract management. Strong knowledge of procurement processes, procedures, and best practices. Experience with ERP/procurement systems such as Oracle, SAP, or similar platforms is preferred. Required Skills Strong analytical skills. Effective negotiation skills. Excellent communication skills. Proven problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple procurement activities and meet tight project deadlines. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with work locations available in Jeddah or Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic procurement team, collaborating with various internal departments and external suppliers to ensure project success.

b95076e0e2ba377f.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Product Management (MarTech) to join Qiddiya Digital. This full-time role involves taking product ownership of MarTech capabilities across Qiddiya’s digital and marketing ecosystem. The Senior Manager will be responsible for translating marketing, digital, asset, and business needs into clear MarTech capabilities, requirements, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Context and Objectives The Senior Manager will collaborate closely with the MarTech Technical Lead, Engineering, Architecture, Data, CRM/GSC, Marketing, Experience Design, Delivery, and vendor teams. The primary objective is to ensure Qiddiya’s MarTech platforms are adopted, governed, and continuously improved. This role is crucial for Qiddiya to retain ownership of its MarTech roadmap, business requirements, platform decisions, and operational knowledge, while ensuring vendor delivery remains transparent, measurable, and aligned with Qiddiya priorities. Key Responsibilities Lead demand intake and prioritization for MarTech use cases across campaigns, journeys, personalization, analytics, content lifecycle, paid media, social, DAM, and publishing. Translate business, marketing, and asset requirements into clear MarTech capabilities, user journeys, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. Own the MarTech product roadmap, priorities, and backlog for platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, AEP, AJO, CJA, Target), DAM / Content Hub, Sprinklr, Workfront, web and app analytics platforms (*, GA4), and mobile measurement platforms (*, Adjust), alongside broader campaign enablement capabilities. Partner with the MarTech Technical Lead to align roadmap priorities with platform architecture, technical feasibility, integration dependencies, security, data readiness, and delivery capacity. Define and maintain product documentation, business process flows, platform requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, operating procedures, and knowledge artifacts. Ensure MarTech capabilities are designed for reuse across Qiddiya assets, brands, channels, and customer journeys. Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, Product, Delivery, Engineering, Architecture, Data Office, CRM/GSC, Cybersecurity, Legal/Privacy, vendors, and external partners. Provide product direction and oversight to vendors and implementation partners, ensuring delivery aligns with Qiddiya standards, priorities, and business outcomes. Support MarTech governance forums by preparing roadmap updates, demand prioritization, risks, decisions, dependencies, value tracking, and adoption reporting. Monitor adoption, campaign performance, customer engagement, platform usage, reporting quality, and business outcomes post-release. Support MarkOps operating model implementation, including campaign intake, approval workflows, QA, launch readiness, reporting, and handover to Marketing. Drive continuous improvement across MarTech processes, platform adoption, automation, content lifecycle, and campaign execution. Ensure platform decisions, requirements, playbooks, and operational knowledge are retained within Qiddiya. Qualifications and Requirements 7+ years of experience in product management, MarTech, digital product, marketing technology, or customer experience platforms. Strong understanding of MarTech platforms and digital experience capabilities, ideally including Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, AEP, AJO, CJA, Target), DAM / Content Hub, Sprinklr, or Workfront. Experience translating business and marketing needs into product roadmaps, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. Experience with campaign lifecycle, customer journeys, segmentation, personalization, analytics, tagging, content operations, social publishing, or marketing operations. Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, consent, customer profiles, digital platforms, and modern delivery practices. Proven experience managing vendors, system integrators, agencies, or outsourced delivery teams. Strong stakeholder management across Marketing, Digital, Product, Engineering, Data, CRM, Legal/Privacy, and vendor teams. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use adoption, campaign, customer, operational, and platform data to guide prioritization. Ability to manage competing priorities, cross-domain dependencies, and complex multi-vendor delivery environments. Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

b9526a81b40c833f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السبع سنابل عن أخصائي إدارة خدمات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتحليل الخدمات، وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية، وتحسين الفاعلية العامة للخدمات المقدمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل وتحديد الخدمات، وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية لتحسين فعاليتها. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات، وعرضها على المعنيين ومناقشتها. تقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظ الوثائق في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. دراسة التجارب والممارسات المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات، وتقييم جدوى الاستفادة منها، ورفع المقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب. إعداد الخطط التشغيلية للخدمات المختلفة بأكبر فعالية ممكنة، وتحليل العمليات والإجراءات لضمان تكاملها وسلامة مساراتها. وضع الحلول المناسبة للمشاكل والتحديات لضمان تقديم الخدمات ضمن أعلى معايير الكفاءة والجودة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة المستجدات في مجال إدارة الخدمات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة الخدمات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الخدمات وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. فهم عميق لأفضل الممارسات في إدارة الخدمات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال للعمليات. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية والإدارية في المجال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحسين جودة وفعالية الخدمات المقدمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

b996288d405e4fdb.job_title: Engineer Methods Structural & Lifting; Zone D
b996288d405e4fdb.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Engineer - Methods Structural & Lifting for Zone D. This full-time role involves preparing and reviewing design analyses, calculations, and procedures for various structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard environment. The incumbent will ensure the safety, efficiency, and reliability of critical engineering operations, focusing on both in-service and pre-service engineering analyses. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review design analyses, calculations, and procedures for structural in-service and pre-service engineering deliverables, including hull structure design, transportation, lifting, installation, vessel deck layout and modification, hull structure erection, and ship lift. Demonstrate familiarity with project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and inter-discipline requirements, identifying concerns early and taking appropriate initiatives. Interface with other departments to obtain necessary input for discipline designs and drawings. Maintain close coordination with other disciplines and entities such as Engineering, Project Management Team, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction. Assist in preparing estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and man-hour estimates. Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and ensure adherence to company procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements. Prepare discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications as required. Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity. Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys as needed. Assist the procurement team in acquiring discipline equipment, materials, and services, ensuring compliance with company objectives and procedures. Review vendor and subcontractor submittals for compliance with project specifications and provide necessary comments. Keep the supervisor informed of all activities and concerns related to technical, budgetary, and manpower aspects. Assist in providing input for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports, including associated productivity. Assist concerned parties with responses to the Company and other entities (*, certifying authorities, auditors, third parties) regarding their review and approval. Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience in the domain. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard or similar heavy industrial environment. The role requires expertise in assessing structures for floating conditions, transportation logistics, lifting operations, onshore installation procedures, vessel deck layouts and modifications, and erection processes.

b999d981de8247f2.description: About the Role SNME Anipsotiki is seeking an HSSE Manager (Health, Safety, Security & Environment) to lead all health, safety, security, and environmental activities for SNA crane and installation scopes. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Shaqra', Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in the field. The role focuses on ensuring that all operations, including lifting, working-at-height tasks, and WTG installation, are planned, controlled, and executed with zero harm to people, equipment, and the environment. Role Purpose and Context The HSSE Manager is responsible for ensuring full compliance with Owner Safety Specifications, client requirements, and Saudi regulations across all project activities. This involves a strong focus on proactive safety measures and continuous oversight to maintain high standards of health, safety, security, and environmental protection throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the project HSSE Plan, Emergency Response Plan, and supporting procedures, ensuring alignment with Owner Safety Specifications (OSS) and client HSSE requirements. Promote a strong safety culture through visible field leadership, daily site presence, and the consistent application of Stop Work Authority for all personnel. Act as SNA's primary HSSE representative to the Owner, Goldwind, and their respective HSSE teams. Attend HSSE coordination meetings and walk-downs to ensure effective communication and collaboration on safety matters. Ensure compliance with all Saudi labor and HSE regulations, including restrictions on outdoor work during summer midday hours and the implementation of heat-stress controls. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in Health, Safety, Security, and Environment management. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage HSSE activities for complex industrial or construction projects. Strong understanding of Saudi labor and HSE regulations. Proven experience in developing and implementing HSSE plans and emergency response procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position requiring on-site presence in Riyadh and Shaqra'. The role involves active participation in field operations and coordination with various stakeholders to ensure a safe working environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b9a2d9da1cba0ef2.description: About the Role SEVEN is seeking a QHSSE Manager for a future opportunity in Jazan. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing all Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental, and Security aspects within complex attractions. The manager will ensure a secure and compliant environment for employees, guests, and assets by conducting audits, delivering training, managing incidents, and coordinating with local authorities. Key Responsibilities Implement SEVEN QHSSE standards across the complex and attraction, aligning with business objectives. Plan and coordinate security resource allocation, budgeting, and staffing for operational efficiency. Act as the primary point of contact for QHSSE matters with internal and external stakeholders, including local authorities. Oversee the budgeting process for QHSSE operations, optimizing resource utilization and controlling expenses. Lead and supervise security personnel, ensuring training and effective duty execution. Develop and implement security policies, procedures, and emergency response plans. Conduct regular risk assessments to identify QHSSE threats and areas for improvement. Manage incidents and emergencies, coordinating with local authorities and internal teams for effective response. Ensure compliance with local regulations, QHSSE standards, and internal policies. Develop and implement training programs for employees, focusing on skills development and emergency response. Implement loss prevention strategies to protect company assets and monitor security systems. Contribute to a positive guest experience by maintaining a safe and secure environment. Managerial Accountabilities Set performance goals for the QHSSE team and monitor progress. Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement agencies and industry partners. Monitor compliance with security policies and procedures, conducting audits and implementing corrective actions. Lead employee performance management processes within the QHSSE department. Promote a culture of safety, integrity, and service excellence within the team. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in QHSE/security management. At least 3 years of experience in a managerial role. Experience in managing QHSE/security operations for large complexes, attractions, or entertainment venues is highly desirable. Experience with ISO audit programs, specifically ISO 9001 or ISO 45001. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jazan, focusing on maintaining QHSSE protocols and procedures across complex attractions. The role involves coordinating with various internal teams and external authorities to ensure a safe and compliant environment. Application Information This is a future opportunity with SEVEN. Salary details will be disclosed during the application process.

b9aa7b95f41dd504.description: About Eram Talent Eram Talent is actively seeking qualified and experienced professionals for various full-time opportunities within the Upstream & Drilling sector. These roles are based in Saudi Arabia and are open to individuals with relevant expertise in the Oil & Gas industry. The Role: Lead Drilling Engineer As a Lead Drilling Engineer, you will contribute to critical operations within the Upstream & Drilling domain. This position requires a professional with a strong technical background and practical experience in the industry, capable of working effectively in a demanding project environment. Key Disciplines Eram Talent is looking for talent across a range of disciplines to support its operations. While this specific posting is for a Lead Drilling Engineer, the broader search includes professionals in: Engineering Drilling Exploration Supply Chain Project Management Construction Inspection Field Compliance Telecommunications Instrumentation & Control IT Support Qualifications and Requirements Candidates for the Lead Drilling Engineer role, and other positions within the Upstream & Drilling sector, should meet the following criteria: Relevant educational qualifications and professional experience in the respective discipline. Previous experience in the Oil & Gas, Upstream, or Drilling industry is preferred. Demonstrated strong technical knowledge and relevant industry experience. Ability to operate effectively within a challenging project environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Upstream & Drilling sector. The work involves operating in a project-focused environment that may present various challenges, requiring adaptability and robust problem-solving skills. Application Process Professionals with the required qualifications and experience in the Oil & Gas industry, particularly in Upstream and Drilling operations, are encouraged to apply for this Lead Drilling Engineer position.

b9dd7a22286778f1.description: About the Role Baker Hughes is seeking a Sales Senior Specialist to join its Oilfield Services business in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves selling products, services, and solutions within a defined geographic area, focusing on intelligent, connected technologies for energy extraction assets. Role Context and Impact The Senior Sales Specialist will manage complex sales processes for important clients, requiring thorough technical knowledge of products and their application environment. The role involves significant technical analysis and adaptation to client conditions, ensuring reliable and efficient operations for customers. Key Responsibilities Selling products, services, parts, solutions, or projects within a specified geographic area or large territory. Handling products and systems that require in-depth technical knowledge and understanding of their operational environment. Managing complex sales processes that involve multiple stakeholders, both internal and external. Developing proposals that integrate technical, economical, logistical, and financial aspects. Managing relationships with important clients for a specific product line. Collaborating with technical colleagues to address customer requests and discuss local conditions. Being involved in medium-sized sales initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in sales, preferably within the oilfield services sector. Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes and client relationships. Strong technical understanding of products and systems relevant to energy extraction. Work Environment and Culture Baker Hughes fosters an inclusive environment that values diversity and individual contributions. The company invests in the health and well-being of its workforce, provides training and rewards talent, and develops leaders at all levels. Flexible working hours are offered to support work-life balance and productivity. b90918a1ecbbebe1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالميه للمقاولات عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد المخاطر المهنية في بيئات ومواقع العمل المختلفة، ووضع برامج للوقاية من الأمراض المهنية، وضمان تطبيق معايير الصحة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات هذه المخاطر على العاملين. توجيه العاملين لإجراء الفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمستويات المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين بيئة العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ مختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر المهنية المختلفة (كيميائية، فيزيائية، إشعاعية، بيولوجية). معرفة قوية بمعايير ومستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج المقبولة. القدرة على تصميم برامج للوقاية من الأمراض المهنية. نوع العمل وموقعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة للقيام بالمهام المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

b9cc01e3880add01.description: About Elia Grid International (EGI) Elia Grid International (EGI) is a global engineering consultancy specializing in complex power system challenges. As part of Elia Group (Belgium) and 50Hertz (Germany), EGI provides high-quality solutions for the energy transition. The multidisciplinary team offers strategic, technical, and regulatory advice in power transmission, along with specialist solutions to an international client base. EGI maintains offices in Belgium, Germany, the UAE, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), Malaysia, and Canada. Role Overview EGI is seeking a Senior Power System Expert to join the team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading technically demanding studies that support the secure, stable, and economic operation of transmission systems. The position focuses on systems with high shares of renewable generation, energy storage, HVDC interconnections, and other converter-based resources. The role requires combining wide-area stability expertise with hands-on EMT modeling, RTDS real-time simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing. Candidates should have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead advanced power-system studies focusing on security of supply, system operation, and renewable-energy integration in transmission systems. Perform and review RMS and EMT stability studies (frequency, voltage, transient, oscillatory, system strength, fault ride-through, subsynchronous) for converter-dominated and weak grids, including multi-infeed and low-short-circuit-ratio conditions. Develop and validate detailed EMT models of wind, solar PV, BESS, HVDC, FACTS, and protection and control systems, including converting RMS models from PowerFactory/PSS/E into PSCAD/EMT models. Build and operate RTDS/RSCAD real-time simulation environments, including reduced-order replica models of large interconnected systems for wide-area stability, oscillation damping, HVDC control, restoration, and remedial-action schemes. Design and run controller-, protection-, and power-HIL tests of converter and HVDC controls, grid-forming and grid-following functions, and protection relays, interfacing RTDS with physical equipment and PMUs. Analyze simulation and HIL results, diagnose root causes of instability or unexpected controller behavior, and define practical mitigation measures. Automate simulation, model benchmarking, and result processing with Python. Prepare technical reports and client presentations, support proposals and tenders, and mentor engineers to build EGI’s regional EMT, RTDS, and HIL capability. Technical Leadership and Project Scope As a Senior Power System Expert, you will provide senior technical leadership on the integration of power-electronic assets into complex transmission networks. This includes assessing system-level stability, security, and performance, developing and validating detailed EMT models, and utilizing RTDS-based replica applications to test controls, protection systems, and grid-support functions under realistic operating conditions. You will be responsible for translating complex technical findings into clear, practical recommendations for grid planning, operational procedures, control design, compliance, and investment decisions. The role involves working on strategic projects for Saudi and international clients, such as transmission-system operators, generators, renewable developers, storage operators, HVDC project developers, manufacturers, and regulators. Work Environment and Opportunities This position offers the opportunity to contribute to the integration of renewable energy, storage, and HVDC within one of the world’s energy-transition markets. It is a senior technical role that combines strategic consultancy, advanced stability analysis, EMT modeling, and hands-on real-time simulation. The role provides international exposure through EGI’s global project portfolio and Elia Group’s TSO expertise. EGI fosters a collaborative, international working environment with opportunities to lead high-impact studies and develop regional RTDS/EMT capabilities. EGI values diversity and inclusion and is committed to promoting gender equality across all organizational aspects, from recruitment to professional development.

b9e863691e38d887.description: About the role This is an entry-level web development role inside a strategy advisory firm, and it exists because the firm's own web presence and internal tools are worked on by people who also have client mandates to run. You would carry the day-to-day build and upkeep of those properties from your first week: the site, the pages we publish for the markets we work in, and the small internal tools that principals and analysts use to get their work done. The scope is practical rather than theoretical, and you would own finished work rather than fragments of someone else's project. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm based in Riyadh, working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. We advise family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Engagements are scoped by the principals who then deliver them, and they often continue past the recommendation into board meetings and the testing of management plans. What you will do Build and maintain the firm's public website, including new pages, content updates, and the fixes that keep a live site working properly. Turn material from principals into clean, readable web pages and documents, matching the firm's own tone rather than a template. Maintain the small internal tools the team relies on, such as a dashboard of live engagements or a shared library of published research. Test pages across browsers and screen sizes, and resolve layout and performance issues as they come up. Write down what you built and how it is maintained, so the next person can pick it up without asking you. Work with whoever is scoping a piece of the site, ask what the page needs to do, and come back with something that does it. What we need from you Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, whether from a degree, a course, or projects you built yourself. Some experience with a modern framework or content management system, and a clear account of what you did in it. Care for how a page reads as well as how it renders: spacing, hierarchy, and text that a client can follow. Comfort working from a short written brief, and asking questions early when the brief is thin. Written and spoken English at a professional level. Arabic is useful for reviewing content, but not required. An interest in how organizations in the Kingdom actually operate, since the site speaks to the people we advise. What success looks like Within six to twelve months, the site should be something principals can point a client to without checking it first. Requests for a new page or a correction should reach you and come back done, without a chase. The internal tools should be used daily by people who would notice if they stopped working. You would also have a record of a few things you fixed that no one asked about, because you saw them and dealt with them. How decisions get made Principals scope the work and decide what the firm publishes, so you would get a brief rather than a ticket queue. You own the build, the sequence of it, and the technical choices inside it, and you would be expected to say when a request will take longer than the person asking assumes. Anything that touches how the firm presents itself to a client goes to the principal who owns that relationship. Escalation is direct: you raise it with the person who scoped it, and if that stalls, it goes to a partner. What the role offers This is a permanent, full-time position, hybrid, based in Riyadh. You would see how an advisory firm presents its thinking to boards and management teams, and how that thinking changes once a decision is made. The web work is real and it is used, and the people reviewing it read closely. You would work alongside principals and analysts rather than in a separate technology function. Who tends to do well here People who write clearly and would rather cut a paragraph than add one. People who can work in a client's own vocabulary without needing a formal specification to begin. People who are comfortable being accountable for a number, a deadline, or a page that has to be right when a principal sends the link. The role suits someone early in their career who wants to see the decision behind the work, not only the ticket in front of them.

b9809e7f36641ff5.job_title: Manager-Internal Audit & Risk Management- Saudi Nationals
b9809e7f36641ff5.description: Aljomaih Energy and Water Company (AEW) develops, invests in, owns and operates conventional power generation, renewable power and water desalination assets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider region largely through project-specific special purpose vehicles (SPVs) and joint ventures with domestic and international partners. The Internal Audit & Risk Management function provides independent and objective assurance and advisory services designed to add value and improve AEW's operations. The function reports functionally to the Board Audit Committee and administratively to the Chief Executive Officer. This role supports the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management across corporate functions, project companies and joint venture entities and is expected to operate credibly with senior management, external auditors, regulators, lenders and shareholder representatives. Overview The Manager, Internal Audit & Risk Management plays a critical role in upholding AEW's ethical, governance and operational integrity. The role plans and executes risk-based internal audits, supports the design and operation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, and advises management on effective risk mitigation and control improvement. The role requires a proactive mindset, strong analytical and report-writing skills, sound judgement in sensitive situations and a working understanding of the utilities development industry - in particular conventional power, renewable power and water projects and the contractual and financing structures through which they are delivered. Your Job Functions (Duties & Responsibilities) Internal Audit Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual risk-based internal audit plan and independently manage and execute internal audits engagement within your assigned area of responsibility. Evaluate & Improve: Conduct comprehensive audits of various business functions, processes and controls, evaluating their effectiveness and identifying areas for improvement. Compliance & Reporting: Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company policies, and prepare clear and concise audit reports that communicate findings, recommendations and remediation plans to senior management and the Board Audit Committee. Follow-up & Monitoring: Monitor and track the implementation of agreed-upon audit recommendations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of identified issues. Policies and Procedures Review: Assist in the review and improvement of company-wide policies, procedures, and management practices. Project, Contract and Capital Expenditure Audits Audit the project development lifecycle from origination and bid through to financial close, construction, commissioning and handover to operations. Contract Assurance: Review compliance with EPC, O&M, PPA/WPA, shareholder and financing agreements, including obligations, milestones, liquidated damages, warranties, insurance and reporting covenants. Capex & Claims: Verify progress payments, variation orders, claims, change management and contingency utilization against contractual entitlement and approved budgets. SPV & JV Governance: Assess governance, delegation of authority and control arrangements at project companies and joint ventures, including access rights available to AEW under shareholder agreements. Risk Management Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual plan to support, manage and execute risk management engagements within your assigned area of responsibility ERM Framework: Collaborate with the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management and senior management to develop, implement & maintain the company's ERM framework, encompassing risk identification, assessment, mitigation and monitoring processes. Risk Assessment & Mitigation: Conduct regular risk assessments to identify and evaluate potential risks facing the company, considering likelihood, impact and cascading effects. Develop and implement effective risk mitigation plans aligned with the overall ERM strategy and internal controls framework. Risk Communication & Monitoring: Maintain an updated risk register and ensure consistent communication of risks to relevant stakeholders. Integrate risk management activities with internal audit processes. Emerging Risks: Analyze emerging risks and trends, proactively adapt the ERM framework and annual plans to address them. Advisory and Ad hoc Engagement Ensure the smooth and effective execution of all Ad hoc or advisory engagements once assigned within expected turnaround time and quality of deliverables. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA preferred. Eight to ten years of relevant professional experience, of which a minimum of four to five years in internal audit, risk management or external audit. Experience with a Big Four firm, leading professional services firm or similar industry is preferred. Demonstrated exposure to IPP/IWP structures, project SPVs, joint ventures, EPC and O&M contracts and project finance is strongly preferred. Track record of reporting to, or presenting at, an Audit Committee or equivalent governance forum. Certifications Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) required or actively pursuing with completion within an agreed timeframe. One or more of the following is preferred: SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, CRMA, CFE, CISA or PMP. ISO 31000 risk management training is an advantage. COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework (2013) and COSO Enterprise Risk Management - Integrating with Strategy and Performance (2017). Understanding of NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls, Saudi Companies Law, applicable corporate governance regulations, ZATCA requirements and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia.

Your expertise will play a vital role in optimizing pipelines, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering world-class visuals. These opportunities are contingent on client needs and project availability. As projects are initiated or client proposals are developed, we will review candidates from this pool and contact those who most closely align with the specific requirements of the co-development opportunity. Develop, optimize, and maintain pipelines and tools for art asset creation and integration. Collaborate with artists and engineers to ensure that assets meet performance, memory, and technical requirements across platforms. Debug and resolve technical issues related to shaders, rendering, and asset optimization. Implement and refine real-time visual effects, lighting setups, and material systems to achieve high-quality visuals. Provide technical support and training to artists, helping them leverage tools and workflows efficiently. Stay up to date with industry trends and technologies, incorporating innovative solutions into workflows. Document tools, pipelines, and best practices to ensure seamless onboarding and knowledge sharing within the team. Experience in VR/AR development or real-time ray tracing technologies. Note: Specific requirements may vary depending on project needs.
